test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following seasons in India is known as the transition season?
solution:
Correct Answer **Retreating Monsoon**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**Retreating monsoons:

 
• During October-November, with the apparent movement of the sun towards the south, the monsoon trough or the low-pressure trough over the northern plains becomes weaker.
 
• This is gradually replaced by a high-pressure system.
 
• The south-west monsoon winds weaken and start withdrawing gradually.
 
• By the beginning of October, the monsoon withdraws
